employee_invites_one_open_per_employee.name: employee_invites_one_open_per_employee
employee_invites_one_open_per_employee.where: "employee_invites"."accepted_at" is null and "employee_invites"."cancelled_at" is null and "employee_invites"."replaced_at" is null

tasks_asked_by_someone.name: tasks_asked_by_someone
tasks_asked_by_someone.value: "tasks"."asked_by_employee_id" is not null or "tasks"."process_key" is not null

tasks_process_source_complete.name: tasks_process_source_complete
tasks_process_source_complete.value:
("tasks"."process_key" is null) = ("tasks"."step_key" is null)
        and ("tasks"."process_run_id" is null or "tasks"."process_key" is not null)

tasks_columns_follow_status.name: tasks_columns_follow_status
tasks_columns_follow_status.value:
("tasks"."status" = 'done') = ("tasks"."done_at" is not null)
        and ("tasks"."done_at" is null or "tasks"."cancelled_at" is null)
        and ("tasks"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("tasks"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        and ("tasks"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("tasks"."cancel_reason" is null)
        and ("tasks"."cancel_reason" is null or btrim("tasks"."cancel_reason") <> '')

time_off_allowance_rules_yearly_entitlem.name: time_off_allowance_rules_yearly_entitlement_columns
time_off_allowance_rules_yearly_entitlem.value:
"time_off_allowance_rules"."kind" <> 'yearly_entitlement' or (
        "time_off_allowance_rules"."entitlement_days" is not null and "time_off_allowance_rules"."entitlement_days_per_week" is not null
        and "time_off_allowance_rules"."entitlement_days" >= 0 and "time_off_allowance_rules"."entitlement_days_per_week" between 1 and 7
        and ("time_off_allowance_rules"."max_days" is null or "time_off_allowance_rules"."max_days" >= 0)
        and "time_off_allowance_rules"."after_years" is null and "time_off_allowance_rules"."extra_days" is null)

time_off_allowance_rules_service_extra_c.name: time_off_allowance_rules_service_extra_columns
time_off_allowance_rules_service_extra_c.value:
"time_off_allowance_rules"."kind" <> 'service_extra' or (
        "time_off_allowance_rules"."after_years" is not null and "time_off_allowance_rules"."extra_days" is not null
        and "time_off_allowance_rules"."after_years" >= 1 and "time_off_allowance_rules"."extra_days" >= 0
        and "time_off_allowance_rules"."entitlement_days" is null and "time_off_allowance_rules"."entitlement_days_per_week" is null
        and "time_off_allowance_rules"."max_days" is null)

time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_mont.name: time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_month_set
time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_mont.value:
("time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start_month" is not null)
        = ("time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start" is not distinct from 'leave_year_from_fixed_date')

time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_day_.name: time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_day_set
time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_day_.value:
("time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start_day" is not null)
        = ("time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start" is not distinct from 'leave_year_from_fixed_date')

time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_vali.name: time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_valid
time_off_policy_versions_fixed_date_vali.value:
"time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start_month" between 1 and 12 and "time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start_day" between 1 and
        case when "time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start_month" = 2 then 28
          when "time_off_policy_versions"."leave_year_start_month" in (4, 6, 9, 11) then 30 else 31 end

time_off_types_default_allowance_with_ba.name: time_off_types_default_allowance_with_balance
time_off_types_default_allowance_with_ba.value:
("time_off_types"."default_entitlement_days" is not null and "time_off_types"."default_bank_holidays" is not null)
        = ("time_off_types"."default_balance" = 'balance_from_allowance')
